subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu streaming card full-content updates cause severe latency regression on long replies

question: Should Feishu streaming cards support an explicitly opt-in append/content mode for deployments where full-content CardKit updates cause multi-minute long-reply latency?
rationale: The code and live reports show a real tradeoff: full-content updates fixed truncation for some Feishu setups, while at least one current deployment reports severe latency and says coalescing alone did not fix it.

options.title: Add Opt-In Append Mode
options.body: Keep full-content as the default, add a clearly documented plugin-local opt-in append/content mode, and require regression proof that the default still prevents truncation.

options.title: Stay Full-Content Only
options.body: Reject append mode and require a different Feishu-supported mitigation, accepting that affected deployments may need to disable streaming until then.

options.title: Wait For More Logs
options.body: Keep the issue open without changing product direction until a maintainer or reporter supplies redacted CardKit request and timing logs from the affected tenant.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In Append Mode
recommendation.body: Keep full-content as the default, add a clearly documented plugin-local opt-in append/content mode, and require regression proof that the default still prevents truncation.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata identifies m1heng as the Feishu community maintainer, and the decision is specific to Feishu plugin behavior rather than core runtime policy.
